what_this_is: Text-quality property names taken from the corpus bottom-up. The papers were selected because their abstracts enumerate kinds of error, by a pattern that names no kind; the property names were then taken from whatever those abstracts put next to the word error. No category list was supplied, and this file does not know what the catalog contains.
why_it_exists: Every other step of this review is deductive. The queries were written from properties somebody already had in mind, the ordering gives 5 points for naming one of the Czech scorer's six, and the per-criterion breakdown counts mentions of what we already measure. None of that can find a property nobody here thought of, which is what the investigator asked for on 2026-10-14.

selection.rule: the abstract or title enumerates kinds of error or quality
selection.pattern: \b(error (?:types?|categor\w+|class\w+|taxonom\w+|typolog\w+)|taxonom\w+ of errors?|typolog\w+ of errors?|(?:quality|error) (?:dimension|aspect)s?|annotation (?:scheme|guidelines?|taxonom\w+)|(?:we|they) (?:annotate|label|categori[sz]e|classify)[^.]{0,40}\berrors?\b|fine[- ]grained errors?|error analysis)\b

extraction.stoplist_is_a_declared_bias: every word in it is about the shape of a sentence or the apparatus of a study, never a property a text can have, so removing it cannot remove a candidate
extraction.not_a_text_property_is_a_judgement: a separate, smaller list of terms this review takes to be about a pipeline or a measurement rather than a text. The terms are kept and flagged rather than dropped, so the judgement can be reversed by whoever disagrees.

limitations: An abstract names a taxonomy far more often than it lists one, so a scheme whose categories live in a table contributes its name and not its contents. Recall is low and this is a floor, not a census. Nothing here is read: a term is a place to look, not a property with a definition.
what_this_does_not_do: It maps nothing onto the catalog. Which of these the candidates already cover is a judgement, made in a separate step and recorded there, because a mapping done here would hide the step where a new property could be talked away.
